Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N,Q and an array of N integers, followed by Q queries each consisting of L,R. Find the GCD of numbers in [L,R]. If there is only one number in the given range, then print the number itself. 
Input Description:
Input Size : 1<=N<=1000 
Sample Input:
5 2
1 2 3 4 5
1 2
4 5 
Sample Output:
1
1
